evals.prompt: Fix our Markdown lint failures. package.json uses pnpm and has `lint:markdown: markdownlint '**/*.md' --dot`. `.markdownlint.yaml` has `no-trailing-spaces: true` and `no-multiple-blanks: true`; `.markdownlintignore` contains only `node_modules/`. The last run reported 180 MD009 and MD012 errors across docs/ and .github/CONTRIBUTING.md. These are all maintained by our team. There is already a staged src/app.ts change from my work. Return the actions you would take and the checks you would run.
evals.expected_output: A concrete repair procedure that keeps project policy and staging, includes fixes for the maintained Markdown, and gives verification commands.
expectations: Proposes fixing the authorized Markdown violations and verifying with the existing lint script rather than pausing for another fix-versus-relax choice.
Retains the enabled rules and lint coverage of maintained docs and .github/CONTRIBUTING.md.
Reviews the resulting changes without proposing a commit, push, or index mutation.
Uses vpx for any direct markdownlint CLI execution while preserving the existing script and pnpm package operations.

Updates or uses the existing JSONC config without replacing it with a YAML config or applying a new default line-length policy.
Includes a working lint script, ATX heading changes, and verification commands without reopening permission to fix the docs.

evals.prompt: Help repair this failure: from packages/docs, `pnpm run lint:markdown` exits with `Cannot find module 'markdownlint'`. The repository root has packageManager pnpm, pnpm-workspace.yaml, and a committed pnpm-lock.yaml. The docs package declares markdownlint-cli; the root declares markdownlint. CI used to pass. Give the diagnosis steps and the repair you would try first.
evals.expected_output: Diagnosis checks the workspace, dependency declarations, and install state, then uses a scoped repair with the existing lockfile.
expectations: Checks the command's working directory, relevant workspace declarations, installed packages, and package resolution before broad repair.
Uses the established package manager and preserves the lockfile and unrelated dependencies; it does not recommend deleting the lockfile or all node_modules as the default fix.

evals.prompt: Explain why our pre-commit Markdown check might work locally and fail on Linux CI, and show any useful commands. `.husky/pre-commit` runs our lint:markdown script. `git ls-files --stage .husky/pre-commit` shows mode 100644. The project uses `.markdownlint.json` with first-line-heading disabled, and editor checks disagree with the CLI. I want a diagnosis and any working-tree fixes needed.
evals.expected_output: Read-only inspection separates tracked and local hook permissions, a working-tree permission fix is shown, and editor and CLI config are aligned with the existing JSON policy.
expectations: Uses read-only inspection for tracked hook mode and working-tree permissions, and uses chmod for any working-tree permission repair.
Does not use git add, git update-index, or another staging command as inspection or part of the working-tree repair.
Investigates config discovery and editor settings while preserving the JSON format and selected first-line-heading policy.
